# beenfar_wifi_network_ap_groups (Resource)

The access point groups that broadcast a wifi network, managed apart from the network itself. Use it when the `beenfar_wifi_network` is managed elsewhere (another configuration, or the UI); do not also set `ap_groups` on that resource.

Destroying it clears the groups, so the network is broadcast by all access points again; the wifi network itself is not touched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Owns only the access point groups of a wifi network that is managed
# elsewhere, for instance in another team's configuration.
resource "beenfar_wifi_network_ap_groups" "corp" {
  wifi_network_id = data.terraform_remote_state.network.outputs.corp_wifi_id
  ap_groups       = ["office", "warehouse"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ap_groups` (Set of String) Access point groups that broadcast the network; empty means all.
- `wifi_network_id` (String) Id of the wifi network.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `wifi_network_id`. Import uses it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the wifi network id.
terraform import beenfar_wifi_network_ap_groups.example <wifi network id>
```
